description: This is a PHPUnit test class for testing the AOS_Invoices module of SuiteCRM. It extends the SuitePHPUnitFrameworkTestCase and contains unit tests for object instantiation, attribute verification, record saving, and deletion behaviors.

classes.name: AOS_InvoicesTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AOS_Invoices module testing various functionalities such as instantiation, attribute correctness, saving, and deletion.
